title: Decision.what vocabulary registry
description: Canonical Decision.what values emitted across AIECP. Per ADR-0026, a procedural linter (scripts/validate-what-vocabulary.mjs) scans every Decision entity's `what` field against this registry and warns on unknown values. This is a soft linter (warnings, not errors) — backwards-compatible, no schema_version bump required. Each entry has: pattern (exact string OR regex), category, description, examples, emitted_by (which skill/workflow produces it), introduced_in (ADR or commit).

entries.description: architecture-design skill detected a conflict between architectural constraints and requirements. Triggers orchestrator's plan_revision_needed transition (NOT goal_not_yet_met).

Suffix is free-form (test_file:test_name:old_selector→new_selector) but the linter does not enforce internal structure — only that the prefix is 'self_heal'. The literal 'self_heal:...' (three dots) is also accepted as a placeholder for the skill's example.

ADR-0034 risk classifier determined the task is 'trivial' (≤5 LOC, .md/.txt/.json only, no security keywords). The fast-path was taken: the full FSM was skipped, the change was applied directly, and this Decision records that the fast-path was used. Emitted by the orchestrator's fast-path state (per ADR-0034).
consumed_by: evaluate-result state (to know the fast-path was taken, not the full FSM)

entries.description: ADR-0034 risk classifier produced a risk assessment. The suffix is the risk level. Emitted by the orchestrator's classify-goal state (or classify-risk state) after calling classifyRisk().

entries.description: product-vision skill completed its market-aware enrichment of requirements-gathering's output. Researched domain standards via web_search (recency-verification), built the Domain Standards table, defined the Core Loop, and wrote the Launch-Ready V1 scope (must-have / wow-factor-targets / core-loop-completeness / post-launch). The orchestrator's quality-gate state REQUIRES this Decision before emitting quality_gate_passed (ADR-0037/0038).
consumed_by: skills/creative-expansion/SKILL.md step 1 (reads specs/product-vision.md for Wow Factor Targets)

entries.description: creative-expansion skill completed its visual/interactive enrichment audit of the implementation. Emitted with four structured arrays in the Decision payload: suggestions (each with priority must-have/should-have/nice-to-have + target_surface), implemented (already present, with evidence), missing (actionable asks), rejected (explicitly rejected with documented reason). The orchestrator's quality-gate state REQUIRES this Decision before emitting quality_gate_passed (ADR-0038); unaddressed must-haves (missing AND no rejected entry with a legitimate reason) cause quality_gate_failed.

orchestrator's quality-gate state verified all three creation-mode enrichment processes ran AND no critical/high gaps remain. Transition to report. In fix mode this is a pass-through (no enrichment needed); in creation mode it requires product_vision_defined + creative_expansion_suggested + red_team findings all addressed. Per ADR-0038 this is a BLOCKING gate, not advisory.
consumed_by: orchestrator transition table (quality-gate → report on quality_gate_passed)

entries.description: orchestrator's quality-gate state found that one or more creation-mode enrichment processes did NOT run, OR critical/high findings remain unaddressed. Transition back to classify-goal with an enriched decomposition naming the missing sub-goals. Per ADR-0038 this is the structural enforcement of Mode-Dependent Virtues — without it, creation mode drifts back to fix-mode minimalism.
consumed_by: orchestrator transition table (quality-gate → classify-goal on quality_gate_failed)

entries.description: self-red-team skill's tour produced a finding (per ADR-0037/0038 creation-mode enrichment). Format: red_team_finding:<severity>:<slug>. Severity is one of critical/high/medium/low/info (mirrors CVSS-style ranking and the risk_classified vocabulary). Slug is free-form snake/kebab-case naming the gap (e.g., missing_upgrade_tree, no_help_flag, save_load_silent). Critical/high findings force quality_gate_failed; medium/low/info are advisory.

notes: This registry is a SOFT linter — warnings only, never errors. A Decision with an unknown `what` is still schema-valid (decision.schema.json allows any string); this linter only flags potential typos / vocabulary drift.

To add a new `what` value: add an entry here AND emit it from the skill/workflow. If you emit a new value without registering it, the linter will warn — that's the prompt to either register it or fix the typo.
Pattern types: 'exact' for fixed strings (e.g., 'architecture_constraint_conflict'), 'regex' for templated patterns (e.g., 'workflow_routed:<workflow-name>').
The registry is consumed by scripts/validate-what-vocabulary.mjs (CLI scanner) and executor/src/evidence-store.ts (runtime warning on emit). Both emit warnings, neither blocks execution.
